title: Rental terms, auto-debit, case-move, arrears follow-up and ATS have no value or name in the sources (APP slice)
source: TSD S5 v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T-A.1; FSD S5 A2.24; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 (R-DIS-25, R-DIS-63); legacy RWB-E4-033
section: s4 Flow, s7 Acceptance criteria, s8 Business rules, s11 Data, s12.2, s12.8, s15
description: The rental step of RWB-E4-033 has no complete target surface. (a) The rental terms (rental start date, tenant reference, term, rent, currency, payment method, auto-debit reference) have no physical column set in TSD S5 T3.1 for asset or asset_sale and no row in the Logical Data Model. (b) The rwb-payment auto-debit request and the rwb-case case-move answer have no published operation name or request shape. (c) The arrears follow-up has no named owner operation and the rental_arrears value of R-DIS-63 has no number. (d) ATS, the Systems cell of R-DIS-25 and an integration point of FSD S5 A2.24.2, has no interface specification in TSD S5 T5.1. (e) The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice. The legacy Data and Endpoints tables also name v_ace_customer, v_ace_account and v_ace_npa_asset reads and a POST valuations operation that this service does not own.
evidence: TSD S5 v2 T3.1 lists asset (DF-COL-028 to DF-COL-042) and asset_sale with no rental column; T5.1 lists INT-11, INT-12, INT-13 and INT-27 only; T-A.1 has API-S5-001 to API-S5-005 and no rental or case move; R-DIS-25 Systems cell = ATS; R-DIS-63 condition = rental_arrears above the threshold with no value; FSD S5 A2.24.2 lists AMIS and ATS as integration points.
proposed: Read the rental set as an addition to asset by the S5 DB story; carry the auto-debit, case-move and rwb-source-data operations with a placeholder name until their owners publish them; keep the money, the arrears value and the notice with rwb-payment and rwb-comms; track ATS and build no interface; trace the slice to FEAT-AST-24, REQ-S5-010 and BR-030.

title: Rental element, consumed operation names, asset key path and Draft baseline have no source shape (CON slice)
source: TSD S5 v2 T3.1, T3.3, T-A.1, T-A.2, T5.1; API Specification v4; Ownership Map v1; legacy RWB-E4-033
section: s7 Acceptance criteria, s11 Data, s12.1, s12.2, s12.8, s16
description: The published contract of the rental step is incomplete in the sources. (a) The Rental element has no physical column set, so its property list, types, lengths and required flags are a contract decision with no source. (b) The operation names and shapes of the rwb-payment auto-debit request, the rwb-case case-move answer and the rwb-source-data asset read are not published. (c) The read path carries the ACE asset business key of API Specification v4 while asset in TSD S5 T3.1 is keyed by a record identifier and carries asset_ref and no business-key column. (d) asset has no row in the Ownership Map table list. (e) The baseline sits in Draft with no approval record, and no source fixes a deprecation window for a published field or the retention of a contract fake. (f) The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice.
evidence: TSD S5 v2 T-A.1 paths are /api/recovery/v1/assets/{assetId}; API Specification v4 carries the business-key path; TSD S5 v2 T3.1 keys asset by DF-COL-028 id (uuid) with DF-COL-031 asset_ref; Ownership Map lists asset_sale and listing for S5 and no asset row; no release note states a deprecation window or fake retention.
area: rwb-asset / contract baseline of the rental step
proposed: Declare the Rental element additively on the Asset element with the eight named properties and two required; carry the three consumed operation names with a placeholder; keep the business-key path and record the divergence from the record key; add the missing asset row to the Ownership Map; tag the baseline in Draft with no approval and one major version with fakes retained for the wave.
